plain_description.what: It re-read the verdicts of the 37-model pilot on clean, content-disjoint data. It counted how often the judge picked the answer-key-correct side, with and without a reference answer. The bar was 0.80 with a reference. No calls were made.
plain_description.why: It checks whether the judge recipe actually used in the new pilot is accurate enough to plan on.
plain_description.information: Below 0.80 would withdraw the older accuracy figure used for pricing future boards. Above it keeps that figure. Result: done. 0.879 [0.833, 0.924] with a reference (bar held) and 0.751 without. This depends on the reference being right, which it was 93% of the time. When the reference is wrong, accuracy falls to 0.26, on only 38 matches. The result covers health and math only.
